youtube_thumbnail.prompt:
YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 aspect ratio, high-contrast B2B webinar recap thumbnail. Follow this creative brief for composition and colors (its text-overlay copy is handled separately, not by you -- see the note below):

**Composition**: Three vertical sections; left shows Priya Nair (headshot, smiling), middle shows Daniel Kim, right shows Sara Alvarez. Each headshot is inside a thin navy circle. ACME Revenue Cloud logo placed in the bottom‑left corner, white on navy background. Background gradient from navy (#001F3F) to dark gray (#0A0A0A). Space reserved at the top for text overlay.  

**Text overlay**:  
- Headline (under 6 words): “Speed-to-Lead: 3.2× Reply Boost”  
- Secondary stat callout (smaller, below headline): “3+ attendees = 2× opportunity rate”  

**Colors**: Primary navy #001F3F, accent cyan #00FFFF for circle outlines and highlights, text white #FFFFFF. (If ACME’s exact brand colors are unavailable, this navy‑plus‑cyan palette provides a clean, professional B2B look.)

Event tag: acmerevenue-2026-07-20. Style: sharp modern sans-serif typography, high contrast, professional corporate webinar/podcast thumbnail aesthetic, crisp studio lighting, 4K quality.

IMPORTANT: Do not render any text, words, letters, or numerals anywhere in the image -- pure photography/composition only. The headline and stat line above describe what a separate, deterministic text overlay will add afterward (see gen_visuals.py) -- leave the top third and bottom-right corner visually clean/uncluttered so that overlay reads legibly once composited on.

infographic_hero.prompt:
Marketing infographic hero graphic, portrait or square, flat vector illustration style, clean modern B2B data-visualization design themed around: "From 3.2x Replies to 14x ROI: Webinar Revenue Levers".

Data points this graphic represents (use only to guide icon choice, panel count, and relative proportions -- e.g. bar heights -- not as text to render):
**3.2x** — lift in reply rate when follow‑up occurs within 4 hours vs next‑day *Daniel Kim, Northwind Analytics [05:10]*  
**≈2x** — higher opportunity conversion rate for accounts with 3+ webinar attendees vs single‑attendee accounts *Sara Alvarez, Meridian Software [06:20]*  
**41%** — increase in webinar‑sourced opportunity creation after reducing internal routing delay from 18 h to <2 h *Sara Alvarez, Meridian Software [11:30]*  
**≈3x** — click‑through‑rate lift from segmented post‑webinar emails (~6% → >17%) vs blanket sends *Sara Alvarez, Meridian Software [28:20]*  
**2.4x** — pipeline‑influenced touches generated by repurposed webinar content vs the live session alone *Daniel Kim, Northwind Analytics [38:42]*  
**11–14x** — return on fully‑loaded event cost (including follow‑up & repurposing) within two quarters *Sara Alvarez, Meridian Software [51:48]*

Layout and color system to follow:
- **Hero section (top):** Large central graphic showing the **11–14x ROI** figure (e.g., a bold badge or icon stack) with the event title and ACME Revenue Cloud logo above it.  
- **Speed panel (just below hero):** Two side‑by‑side stat blocks – **3.2x reply‑rate lift** (left) and **41% opportunity‑creation boost** (right). Use a simple before/after arrow or bar‑chart icon to visualize the lift.  
- **Segmentation panel (middle):** Two blocks – **≈2x multi‑attendee conversion** (left) and **≈3x CTR lift from segmentation** (right). Represent each with a paired bar chart (baseline vs optimized) or a “×” multiplier icon.  
- **Content Repurposing panel (lower middle):** Single block for **2.4x pipeline‑influenced touches** – show a small funnel or layered‑content icon (live session → blog/social/infographic) with the 2.4x multiplier.  
- **CTA section (bottom):** Full‑width bar with a concise call‑to‑action (“Get the full playbook & checklist”) and a button‑style link to the follow‑up resources. Include the webinar date and a tiny QR code or short URL if desired.  
- **Color system:**  
  - Primary: ACME Blue (#0066CC) for headers, hero number, and key icons.  
  - Accent: Teal (#00C5B7) for secondary stats and chart highlights.  
  - Neutral: Dark Gray (#333333) for body text and background; Light Gray (#F5F5F5) for panel backgrounds to keep the six stats visually unified.  

This flow guides the viewer from the ultimate ROI outcome backward through the levers that drive it, reinforcing that each numeric improvement compounds into the final return.

Event tag: acmerevenue-2026-07-20. Style: crisp geometric icons, generous whitespace, grid-aligned panels, professional SaaS marketing infographic aesthetic, sharp vector shapes, high resolution.

IMPORTANT: Do not render any text, words, numerals, or typography anywhere in the image -- pure flat-vector icons, panels, charts, and color only. Leave a clean, uncluttered band across the top (roughly the top 12%) and across the bottom (roughly the bottom 30%) -- a headline and a data-points legend will be composited into those bands afterward, deterministically (see gen_visuals.py).
